one_liner_zh: 標普全球公佈最新季度財報，營收年增10.41%但每股盈餘低於市場預期。
one_liner_en: S&P Global reported Q2 earnings with 10.41% YoY revenue growth, but EPS missed analyst estimates.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期，每股盈餘4.87美元低於預估的5.02美元
highlights_zh: 營收達到41.5億美元，較去年同期成長10.41%
核心業務展現韌性，受惠於金融市場數據與評等需求
維持穩健的營運現金流與資本配置紀律
highlights_en: Revenue reached $4.15B, representing a 10.41% year-over-year increase
Core businesses demonstrated resilience driven by market data and rating demands
Maintained robust operating cash flow and disciplined capital allocation
risks_zh: 每股盈餘表現未達市場預期，引發成本控制的疑慮
總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響債券發行與評等業務表現
risks_en: EPS missing consensus estimates raised concerns over cost management
Macroeconomic uncertainty could impact debt issuance and rating activity
ai_view_zh: 觀點：此次財報營收穩健但盈餘失落，顯示成本壓力或投資支出高於預期。短中期股價可能面臨整理格局。追蹤指標應關注營業利益率變化、債券發行市場復甦進度及訂閱業務續約率。
ai_view_en: view: Solid revenue growth paired with an EPS miss indicates potential cost pressures or higher-than-expected investments. Near to mid-term share price may face consolidation. Track operating margin trends, debt issuance market recovery, and subscription renewal rates.
